title: Implement deterministic ChannelGateway core contracts
requirements: Implement a pure, deterministic ChannelGateway core and typed safe contracts for TELEGRAM and VK using trusted ChannelContext with opaque integration_id, external_sender_id, conversation_id and event_id.

Expose ReadCatalog, ReadDraft, SaveDraft(expected_version, answers, step, event_id), SubmitInquiry(normalized business fields, draft_version, submit_event_id) and ResetDraft(expected_version, event_id) through ports; do not add SDKs, HTTP webhooks, persistence, logging, raw payload handling or real inquiry creation.
Reject unknown fields, malformed IDs, invalid versions and invalid transitions without mutation; user data cannot override trusted context and TELEGRAM/VK namespaces remain separate.
Keep business-flow questions unspecified where the accepted docs do not define a table of steps; enforce only safe contract and optimistic-version invariants.
acceptance: Telegram and VK contexts have equivalent typed operation contracts while their namespaces cannot collide.
Trusted context is immutable and never sourced from user answers; strict shapes and normalized business fields reject unknown or unsafe input.
Version/event validation and rejected operations are deterministic and demonstrably side-effect free through pure tests.
No external calls, storage, raw platform payloads, PII/secrets logging, HTTP routes or submission side effects are introduced.

shared_paths_approval.reason: Accepted internal bot contract core with no external or persistence side effects.
